in_hebrew.name: Stanko
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Stanko הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Slavic word ‘stanku’, meaning ‘garland’ or ‘wreath’. In the Middle Ages, Stanko was a popular name for boys born into noble families, symbolizing prosperity and wealth.

in_greek.name: Stanko
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Garland, Wreath
in_greek.long_meaning: Stanko είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Slavic word ‘stanku’, meaning ‘garland’ or ‘wreath’. In the Middle Ages, Stanko was a popular name for boys born into noble families, symbolizing prosperity and wealth.

in_latin.name: Stanko
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Garland, Wreath
in_latin.long_meaning: Stanko est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Slavic word ‘stanku’, meaning ‘garland’ or ‘wreath’. In the Middle Ages, Stanko was a popular name for boys born into noble families, symbolizing prosperity and wealth.
